title: Sorting the fruit bowl
checked: Every reachable state checked (3 states, 13 with their data, 13 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 3 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
Each pick takes one fruit from the bowl of twelve.
The four places together hold every fruit picked so far, once each.

rules.rule: Sorted only when the bowl is empty
rules.says: Every fruit has its place only after the twelfth is picked.
rules.path: Take away the last fruit guard and it breaks in 1 step: next fruit.
